messages:
anya: Heads-up: support ticket — streaming request fell back and customer saw both a provisional + final charge for the same toolcall.

ravi: Trace?

anya: short logs:
```
2026-05-01T08:27:57Z INFO sess=xy42 route=primary emit=prefix(48) prov=48 tool=tc-322
2026-05-01T08:27:58Z WARN sess=xy42 fallback=us-west-2
2026-05-01T08:27:58Z INFO sess=xy42 route=us-west-2 resume=1 committed=1 tool=tc-322 confirmed=132
```

luke: Same tool id across routes. Our ledger key included route so the fallback wrote a separate provisional row. Commit didn't reconcile.

diana: Quick UX mitigation: hide provisional rows from hosted billing summary and surface only confirmed totals. Add hover text explaining reconcilations.

ravi: Longer fix: change uniqueness to (session_id, toolcall_id, attempt_id?) where attempt_id is client-supplied when available. If attempt_id missing, dedupe across routes.

anya: Telemetry: emit token.provisional.created, token.commit.applied, token.reconciled.adjustment. Tag events with route and attempt_id.

luke: Migration sketch: add nullable attempt_id column, write new rows with attempt_id when present, switch reconciliation to ignore route for null attempt_id rows, run backfill for last 14 days.

diana: For Dedicated customers add config to preserve current real-time provisional visibility. CS note required.

ledger-bot: Created INF-5730 and linked CT-10422.

ravi: Action items: Ill PR DB change, anya will update console mock, luke will draft backfill query.

anya: Thanks — leaning to hide provisional in hosted UI ASAP and roll DB change in canary with reconcile job.
